design_decisions.title: test_assertion_tracks_current_plan_contract
constraints: Repair only the stale test expectation or a narrowly justified test fixture; do not weaken _load_refactor_plan or orchestration production behavior.
Prefer an explicit expected work_queue ID list or a current count of 12 with assertions for web_compatibility_boundary status=planned and android_compatibility_plan status=planned.

implementation_steps.detail: Run git status --short --branch, git rev-parse HEAD origin/main, and inspect the failing test plus current Flutter Forge REFACTOR_PLAN.md. Treat this task JSON as expected planning input and stop if unrelated Agent Hub changes exist.

Update tests/test_refactor_plan_orchestration.py so the real Flutter Forge plan assertion matches the current generated plan contract and explicitly validates the planned Web compatibility entry. Keep production orchestration unchanged.

Run the targeted RefactorPlanLoaderTest tests, then run the complete Agent Hub unittest suite. Record the exact test counts and any remaining failures; do not classify shadow/golden residuals as fixed by this test change.

Inspect git diff --check and git diff. Stage only the focused test change and this task JSON if repository convention requires it. Create one local commit with message test(agent-hub): align refactor plan count. Do not push. Verify git show --name-status HEAD and origin/main remains unchanged.
